newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Primetown buys 1.6 ha lot in Fort Bonifacio.
newsitem.headline: Primetown buys 1.6 ha lot in Fort Bonifacio.

text.p: High-rise developer Primetown Property Group Inc said on Tuesday it had signed a contract to buy 1.6 hectares of land within the Fort Bonifacio Global City, the country's next business district.
The Fort Bonifacio Global City is to be developed by the Fort Bonifacio Development Corp which is majority owned by an 18-company consortium led by diversified concern Metro Pacific Corp.
The sale is the first contract signed by Fort Bonifacio with a real estate developer outside the consortium.
Primetown is planning to build the first of a twin 42-storey tower on an 8,300 square metre lot, an official said.
